{{short description|American-born mathematician}}
'''Naiomi Tuere Cameron''' is an American mathematician working in the field of [[combinatorics]]. She is a professor at [[Spelman College]] as well as the vice president of [[National Association of Mathematicians]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://spelman.edu/academics/faculty/directory/new-faculty/naiomi-cameron|title=New Faculty {{!}} Spelman College|website=spelman.edu|language=en|access-date=2020-02-11}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nam-math.org/about-us.html|title=Board of Directors|website=www.nam-math.org|access-date=2020-02-11|archive-date=2021-02-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210214193938/https://www.nam-math.org/about-us.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was previously an associate professor at [[Lewis & Clark College]] in Portland, OR.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lclark.edu/live/news/38469-catching-up-with-mathematics-professor-naiomi|title=Catching Up With Mathematics Professor Naiomi Cameron|work=Newsroom|publisher=Lewis & Clark College|date=March 21, 2018|first=Mara|last=Sleeter|accessdate=2020-08-05}}</ref>

Cameron was born in [[Washington, D.C.]] and raised in [[Providence, Rhode Island]]. She attended [[Howard University]] for her undergraduate and graduate school, receiving both her B.S. and  PhD in Mathematics.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=mgp/>  In 2019, she was featured on ''[[Mathematically Gifted & Black|Mathematically Gifted and Black]]'' as a Black History Month 2019 Honoree.<ref name=mgp>{{Cite web |title=Naiomi Cameron |url=https://mathematicallygiftedandblack.com/honorees/naiomi-cameron/ |access-date=2020-06-12 |website=Mathematically Gifted & Black |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Research ==
Cameron's academic work has been focused on [[Enumerative combinatorics|enumerative]] and [[algebraic combinatorics]] and [[number theory]]. Her thesis for her dissertation in 2002 was ''Random Walks, Trees and Extensions of Riordan Group Techniques''.<ref name=":0" /> Her other publications include:

* {{Cite journal|last1=Cameron|first1=Naiomi T.|last2=Killpatrick|first2=Kendra|date=2015-06-01|title=Inversion polynomials for permutations avoiding consecutive patterns|journal=Advances in Applied Mathematics|language=en|volume=67|pages=20–35|doi=10.1016/j.aam.2015.03.002|issn=0196-8858|doi-access=free|arxiv=1402.5211}}
* {{Cite journal|last1=Cameron|first1=Naiomi|last2=Killpatrick|first2=Kendra|date=2013-11-01|title=Symmetry and Log-Concavity Results for Statistics on Fibonacci Tableaux|journal=[[Annals of Combinatorics]]|language=en|volume=17|issue=4|pages=603–618|doi=10.1007/s00026-013-0198-1|s2cid=121407867|issn=0219-3094}}

== Additional work ==
Cameron is the vice president of the [[National Association of Mathematicians]] for the 2019–2020 term.<ref name=":1" />
